title: mfin-8k_20200923.htm
关键词: Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share
主要内容: On September 23, 2020, Freshstart Venture Capital Corp entered into a material definitive agreement. Medallion Financial Corp entered into amendments to the Loan Agreement and Note with the U.S. Small Business Administration. The amendments extended the maturity date of the Loan Agreement and Note until the maturity date of the Company’s publicly-traded 9.000% Senior Notes currently due April 15, 2021, provided that upon refinancing, the maturity date would be the earlier of the Replacement Debt’s maturity date or April 30, 2024. The outstanding loan balance as of the date of the Amendments is approximately $14.0 million. The Amendments include Amendment No. 11 to Note and Amendment No. 12 to Loan Agreement, both dated and effective as of September 23, 2020, by and between U.S. Small Business Administration and Freshstart Venture Capital Corp.

股票实体.名称: Common Stock, par value $0.01 per share
